summary: Aura Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 19, 2026, containing its 2025 Sustainability Report. The document discloses environmental, social, and governance performance aligned with GRI and SASB standards for the year ended December 31, 2025. It mentions the completed acquisition of Mineração Serra Grande S.A. in December 2025 but does not announce any new special-situation event. No deal terms or specific transactions are disclosed. This is a routine sustainability disclosure, not a special situation filing.
